response.sql: WITH per AS (SELECT transref, AVG(anlycount) AS avg_anly FROM sentimentandfundamentals GROUP BY transref), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_anly) AS o FROM per), kept AS (SELECT p.transref, p.avg_anly FROM per p, overall o WHERE p.avg_anly > o.o), kept_avg AS (SELECT AVG(avg_anly) AS k FROM kept) SELECT kp.transref, kp.avg_anly AS avg_anlycount, kp.avg_anly - o.o AS diff_from_overall_avg, kp.avg_anly - ka.k AS diff_from_kept_avg FROM kept kp, overall o, kept_avg ka ORDER BY diff_from_kept_avg DESC NULLS LAST, kp.transref LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: The overall average is the unweighted mean of per-transaction averages, excluding transactions whose anlycount values are all NULL (their average is NULL and AVG skips it). Such transactions are not kept, since NULL is not greater than the overall average.
Ties on the final difference are broken by transref ascending, which the request does not specify.
